description: Kadro, Askida, Cetele and Inecek Var dependency updates: weekly, grouped, never merged automatically. Security alerts open pull requests outside the schedule.

packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the npm dependencies, except the Expo SDK family below.
Expo SDK packages move together with the SDK release (the overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml and expo-doctor hold the alignment), so they get their own group and major updates are reviewed by hand.
Major updates open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
Workflow actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and updated in one weekly group.
Askida server: one weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the Composer dependencies; the composer.json ranges stay, only composer.lock moves.
Askida app: one weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the Flutter (pub) dependencies; the pubspec.yaml ranges stay, only pubspec.lock moves.
Askida app: Android Gradle dependencies (Play Integrity and the build plugins) in one weekly group.
Askida: major updates of Composer, pub and Gradle dependencies open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.

Cetele: Gradle dependencies and plugins of the server (cetele/server) in one weekly group. The Spring Boot BOM versions follow the spring-boot plugin entry, so Boot moves on its own pull request below.
packageRules.groupName: cetele server gradle minor and patch

packageRules.description: Cetele: Gradle dependencies and plugins of the Android app (cetele/android) in one weekly group; the Compose BOM, Kotlin, KSP and AGP entries are pinned together by ADR-0001, so a Kotlin or AGP update is reviewed with its KSP and Compose pair.
packageRules.groupName: cetele android gradle minor and patch

packageRules.description: Cetele: major updates of Gradle dependencies open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
Cetele: the Gradle wrapper of both roots, one pull request each (the wrapper checksum is validated in CI).
Cetele: container images of the local stack (docker-compose.yml) in one weekly group; digests stay pinned.

Inecek Var: Angular, Nx and the Angular test and lint plugins move together (the @nx/angular peer range bounds the Angular major), so they get their own weekly group and major updates are reviewed by hand.
Inecek Var: Ionic and Capacitor packages (the Capacitor plugins share the core major) in one weekly group.
Inecek Var API: the pyproject.toml ranges stay, only uv.lock moves.
Inecek Var API: one weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the Python dependencies.
Inecek Var: the Capacitor Android Gradle files and wrapper in one weekly group; the Android Gradle plugin follows the Capacitor major.
Inecek Var: container images of the local stack (docker-compose.yml) in one weekly group.
Inecek Var: major updates of Python and compose dependencies open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
node-forge (ADR-0043) and braces (ADR-0078) carry the two advisories ignored in pnpm-workspace.yaml; no patched release exists, so no update is proposed until the ADRs are reviewed.
